title: WarrenLovesTweaks
description: Broad and various changes to general gameplay. Mostly made for my friends and i.
body:
This is a datapack i made for a server with friends that is packed with various tweaks that we agreed upon. Balancing & crafting changes mostly.
There will probably by updates to this pack as we continue to think of things we want as we play.

The changelog is availible in game by typing
/dialog show [username] warrenlovestweaks:changelog

Infinity is compatible with Mending & Crossbows.
Infinity now gives 75% chance to not consume arrow. Tipped arrows can be used with infinity
Wood planks now work in stone cutter
Thorns can appear on all armor pieces, not just chestplates
Lunge no longer consumes hunger
Armadillos & Turtles may drop scutes on death
Evokers no longer drop totems of undying during raids
Resin can be used as replacement for coal
Logs smelt into 2 charcoal
Unpack blocks like amethyst and quartz
Sniffers can dig up golden dandelions
Happy ghasts drop ghast tears on death
Goats drop mutton, and may drop common goat horns
Nautilus always drop their shell
